title: One run through the five kinds of state
design_ref: Five kinds of agent state; The architecture at a glance
purpose: Run a coding agent from ticket to finished pull request, stopping where it waits for a reviewer, and find each kind of its state in the place the design says it lives.

checks.description: the run reached the review step and is waiting for a person
checks.because: The agent decided to read the reviewer's comment, which needs approval, so the workflow waits on a signal.

checks.description: while it waits, the run holds no sandbox
checks.because: The workflow deleted the sandbox after the last snapshot and before waiting.

checks.description: the engine holds the run's history, and kept it short by continuing as new
checks.because: Every five steps the workflow ends its history and starts a fresh one with only the session, the step and the snapshot. The context stays in the database.

checks.description: the context log holds the ticket, the model's answers and the tools' results
checks.because: Each step appends to an append-only log in the session database. Prompts are rebuilt from it.

checks.description: each file-changing step left a snapshot in S3, and a file that did not change was not uploaded again
checks.because: A snapshot is a manifest of file hashes, and a file is uploaded only if its hash is new. The second snapshot had two files and skipped the one the first already stored. (If an earlier run stored the same bytes, nothing is uploaded at all.)

checks.description: the branch and the pull request are in the ledger and exist once in the external system
checks.because: The tool gateway records each external effect before and after making it.

checks.description: the run completed after the reviewer's approval
checks.because: The approval is a signal to the waiting workflow. It continued from the recorded state.

checks.description: the model was called exactly once for each of the eleven decisions
checks.because: One recorded activity per decision. Continuing as new twice did not repeat any.

checks.description: one pull request, one branch, and two comments (the reviewer's and the agent's) exist
